title: ExTrash
body: ![ExTrash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b408e2186c934b3a11a80ef08db15fc857aa9a8.png) # ✦ ExTrash A lightweight, professional trash GUI plugin for Paper servers. Clean. Safe. Modern. --- ## ✦ Overview **ExTrash** provides a simple inventory-based trash system. Open the GUI → Drop your items → Close it → Items are permanently deleted. No drops. No returns. No duplication. No lag. Built for modern Paper servers. --- ## ✦ Features • `/trash` command • Permanent item deletion on close • Full dupe protection • Async trash history logging • Per-player cooldown • Blacklisted items support • Configurable GUI title & size • Filler glass layout • Configurable sounds • Fully customizable config & messages • Clean, optimized codebase --- ## ✦ Commands `/trash` – Open trash GUI `/trash reload` – Reload configuration Aliases configurable inside `config.yml`. --- ## ✦ Configuration ExTrash automatically generates: • `config.yml` • `messages.yml` • `trash-history.log` Everything is configurable: • GUI size • Title • Cooldown • Logging • Sounds • Permissions • Blacklisted items • Click behavior --- ## ✦ Compatibility • Paper 1.19+ • Tested on 1.20.1 • Compatible with 1.21.x --- ## ✦ Why ExTrash? Minimal. Powerful. Professional. --- # ✦ ExTrash Clean your inventory the right way.
